The Mystery Inch, X:11

This is setting #1 transposed to the key of A dorian.

Play it on a “B” whistle (B natural, not Bb) or on a “B” uilleann chanter and it comes out in the correct key.

I moved a couple notes which would be “high C” down to “A” to smooth out the melody line.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on May 17th, 2026.

The Mystery Inch, X:12

I’ve been playing this jig in B minor lately (after learning it in F#m) which I’ve been really enjoying. The fingering is similar on a banjo/mandolin/fiddle as you just bump everything down a string. It makes it a warmer, deeper tune and as a bonus is quite playable on GDAD bouzouki which is my main instrument! Did this simple transcription of it without ornaments.

↳ Posted by Richard Lam on October 8th, 2026.
